_comment: Recorded from GET https://api.openverse.org/v1/audio/?q=calm+ambient&license_type=commercial&page_size=3 on 2026-08-23, trimmed to the fields the adapter reads. Kept verbatim (including the Jamendo 'mp32' filetype and the non-ASCII creator name) so the tests exercise what the API actually returns rather than a tidied version of it. Tests never hit the network.
